correctness.rationale: A natural simultaneous arm-and-label equivariant graph spine has V=m(m+1)(m+5) and E=3m²(m+1). Its connectivity and one-dimensionality give integral H1 rank 1+m(m+1)(2m-5). For arbitrary arm permutation with f fixed arms, t two-cycles and u three-cycles, the exact fixed vertex/edge counts for particle classes (identity, transposition, three-cycle) are (f(f+1)(f+5),3f²(f+1)), (2t(f+1),2tf), (3u,0). Thus 1−Vg+Eg yields the uniform character. Independent executable models verify all 5220 actions at m=3..6 and three cubical subdivisions at m=3; finite tests corroborate but do not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: Three labeled particles moving on an arbitrary m-arm star are a canonical first substantial joint-symmetry problem in graph braid topology. The formula gives all mixed homology traces uniformly in m, separates fixed-arm, paired-arm and triple-arm effects, and proves the global arm-invariant subspace is zero. It contains structural information absent from nonequivariant Betti numbers and separate restricted symmetry representations.
